title: YES It Slices, BUT...
text:
YES It Slices, BUT.... I was fully prepared for this to not work at all. I make my own bacon and smoked turkey for sandwiches. Cutting the bacon is a pain and I thought I would try this. There are many limitations.

Pros:
It does slice. I partially froze my homemade bacon and it cut it very well

Cons:
Limited instructions. Not much help as far as putting it togther, and virtually none about getting it apart.

Very hard to use. The safety feature on this means that you have to depress 2 buttons and hold them while you are slicing. All this while trying to manage the carriage and feed your food into the blade.

The platform is barely large enough to slice anything meaningful. To do the bacon I had to take the moving parts out of the grooves to make my slab fit on the platform.

The setting for thickness needs to be constantly adjusted. It moves on it's own and before you know it you are getting thicker and thicker.

Exceptional hard to clean. This is the part that worries me the most. The part that folds up at the bottom doesn't come off. Food is trapped in that juncture between the platform and the machine/blade. No instructions on taking the blade off either. But there is a slot in the center hub to lock and unlock the lad. Use a screwdriver and then I used the screw driver to carefully release the blade. I wiped the not removable parts the best I could with hot soapy water on a cloth, and then finally took some clorox wipes and went over all the nooks and crannies.

Very cheaply constructed and I expect this to last no more than a year before the plastic parts crack or break.

All in all, it will cut, but not much more.
